grid.labels: rows A-F top to bottom, columns 1-16 left to right

pitch.note: world units; multiply x by 52.5 and y by 34 for approximate metres

notes.coordinates: world units, NOT pixels; player pixel positions are not derivable from these logs (the camera tracks the ball)
notes.in_frame: this file describes every player ON THE PITCH. Which of them is in shot is a camera property; the measured end-frame count is ground_truth.players_in_frame_last
notes.officials: referee and assistants render at 2% scale and are invisible; they are not in this graph and never count as players
